# `csharp_blank_lines_around_type`

Blank lines before and after each type declaration.

## Values

| Value | Notes |
|---|---|
| `<integer>` | Any integer. |

**Default:** `1`

## Conformance

No known case where Curb's output is not a fixed point of `dotnet format` — see [conformance](../../design-principles/conformance.md).

### `csharp_blank_lines_around_type = 1`

```ini
csharp_blank_lines_around_type = 1
```

::::{tab-set}

:::{tab-item} Before
```csharp
namespace N;

public class Outer
{
    public class Inner1 { }
    public class Inner2 { }
    public class Inner3 { }
}
```
:::

:::{tab-item} After
```csharp
namespace N;

public class Outer
{
    public class Inner1 { }

    public class Inner2 { }

    public class Inner3 { }
}
```
:::

::::
